intervals.label: CMD-3 data taking at VEPP-2000
intervals.locator: E. Solodov for the CMD-3 Collaboration, "Update - News from CMD-3", Phi to Psi 2026 workshop (Pisa, 8 June 2026), slide 8 ("More data (x3) to be collected (2024-2026(7?))") and slide 38 (plans: "Continue data taking")
intervals.note: Year precision. As of the 8 June 2026 talk the collaboration is still taking data: slide 8 says "2025 data were collected with the reverse direction of the beams" and "More data (x3) to be collected (2024-2026(7?))"; slide 38 says "Then we plan to have 1-2 year break for detectors upgrades", after the data taking of the next two years. The start year follows experiments/cmd-3.json, which cites the IPAC-2017 abstract for it ("VEPP-2000 e+e− collider at BINP was commissioned and started data taking with two detectors in 2010 with old injection chain"; the abstract does not name the detectors).
intervals.quote: 2025 data were collected with the reverse direction of the beams ... We plan to finish low-energy scan and take some dedicated high energy data over next two years

summary.plain: The CMD collaboration of the Budker Institute and partner institutes, which has built and run the CMD-1, CMD-2 and CMD-3 detectors at VEPP-2M and VEPP-2000 since 1979.
summary.technical: CMD Collaboration (BINP, Novosibirsk): history since 1979: CMD-1 at VEPP-2M 1979-1984, CMD-2 commissioning 1984-1992 and experiments 1992-2000, CMD-3 from 2000 and taking data at VEPP-2000 since 2010 (still taking data in 2025-2026 per the collaboration's 8 June 2026 workshop talk); membership list not retrieved.
